statusMeaning: Evidence-backed proposal complete; implementation and product acceptance remain pending editor review.
recommendation: Repair and connect existing systems; no wholesale replacement or renderer build.
rankingMethod: Qualitative impact, recurrence and evidentiary confidence are separately justified, not a confidence score authorizing actions. Ranking is proposed remediation priority, not estimated population incidence.

rootCauses.title: Task meaning is changed or incompletely reconciled before admission
rootCauses.recurrence: Multiple stories and independent subspan, merge, keyword and participant probes
rootCauses.confidence: high for observed failures; prevalence outside audited cases unknown
rootCauses.causalExplanation: The wrong visual demand makes later ranking optimize the wrong pool. Exact authored subspan is expanded; reference occurrences trigger false plurality; distinct rates/shares merge; evidence/relationship duties are inconsistently consumed.

rootCauses.title: Consumers reconstruct different task contracts and routes
rootCauses.recurrence: Actual focused consumer adds 22 families to each of 12 route-ineligible tasks; independent quote-route probe
rootCauses.causalExplanation: Gallery, focused review and general requirements consume different projections. A correct route can disappear when task fields are omitted; no-template is mislabeled as missing candidate.

rootCauses.title: Receipt presence and structural validity are mistaken for task-bound evidence
rootCauses.recurrence: Empty hashed handoffs mark 73 data-required and 104 media-required tasks bound; altered receipts/values and stale adapter probes pass
rootCauses.confidence: high for acceptance defects; factual error prevalence unmeasured
rootCauses.causalExplanation: The general path can claim bound requirements without content coverage. Existing schema and immutable hashes are useful but must validate the meaning and coverage of consumed assignments.

rootCauses.title: Capability metadata and admission rules do not expose permitted treatments consistently
rootCauses.recurrence: 442 records, 11 without capability; both timeline scenes fail scope; qualitative spatial/variant contradictions
rootCauses.confidence: high for metadata/predicate mismatch; native fit remains unknown
rootCauses.causalExplanation: A broad data union admits weak discovery candidates while missing scope compatibility and optional/required encoding distinctions hide plausible families.

rootCauses.title: Family selection and display truncation precede complete treatment reconciliation
rootCauses.recurrence: 60 review-record replays: 5,788 sibling suppressions, 232 slide-cap and 1,168 display-limit omissions; no duplicate-family flooding observed
rootCauses.confidence: high for stage order; omitted valid-fit count unknown
rootCauses.causalExplanation: One family representative is chosen before feasibility, even in exhaustive-family mode. Display omission is not evidence that a family or variant cannot fit.

rootCauses.title: Media demand and supply are not consistently reconciled per treatment
rootCauses.recurrence: Three explicit mediaNeeds proposals marked not-required; current general handoffs lack task coverage; scoped historical supply/framing failures
rootCauses.confidence: high for contract gap; current availability must be checked fresh
rootCauses.causalExplanation: Good template choices and wrong media, or good media and wrong pairing, are separate outcomes. Missing assets must produce a precise sourcing gap rather than a false template verdict.

rootCauses.title: Review and run provenance is insufficient for reliable causal evaluation
rootCauses.recurrence: 33/60 normalized current contexts used a different gallery; historical intermediate scores/pool absent; Job 4 catalog attribution corrected by Job 5
rootCauses.causalExplanation: Feedback can be applied to the wrong task representation and historical order cannot be reproduced. Audit-only sidecars fix analysis, not production export.

rootCauses.title: Evaluation measures structural completion more reliably than editor-quality correctness
rootCauses.recurrence: Gold boundary matches 307 Future/113 Year; 439 heterogeneous review records; held-out fixture has unresolved fits and pending human approval
rootCauses.confidence: high for measurement limits; repair quality remains untested
rootCauses.causalExplanation: Signature coverage, passing fixtures and intact fields are not independent quality acceptance. Review sampling merges meaningful differences and reviewed stories are no longer untouched tests.

definitions.beat: Ordered narrative container with exact script spans and speaker/section context; not automatically one shot.
definitions.claim: Source-grounded semantic assertion or attributed utterance with exact span and provenance; a punctuation sentence may contain several.
definitions.semantic_visual_moment: Smallest coherent presentation interval whose required meanings can be satisfied together by an existing treatment or explicit route; can cross claims or use a subspan.
definitions.visual_job: Template-neutral communicative relationship/action required in that moment; not a template name or broad subject.
definitions.presentation_contract: Validated account of required meanings, participants, exclusions, readability, order, evidence and route constraints for a moment, derived without inventing facts.
definitions.template_capability: Versioned evidence about an existing family/variant and supported controls, separating observed sample behavior from verified editable range.
definitions.candidate: Existing template plus a specific permitted treatment plan under consideration, with explicit compatible/incompatible/unresolved outcomes; neither selected nor proven fit merely by retrieval.
definitions.route: Typed disposition such as existing template, exact source footage, b-roll, still/cutout with supported text treatment, continuation, or unresolved; no-template can be correct.
definitions.review_evidence: Authored decision/comment bound to exact displayed task/candidate/version, source order, scope and status; separate from model judgments or derived summaries.
definitions.native_fit: Task-bound evidence that the exact existing composition/control plan can meet content, timing and readability requirements; a slot count, tag or mapping alone is insufficient.

evaluationMetrics.definition: Recovered editor-accepted task+treatment alternatives / all adjudicated valid alternatives in the version-bound set. Report discovery, admission, reconciled and displayed recall separately; unknown native fit is a separate denominator.
evaluationMetrics.proposedGate: 100% on agreed critical regression alternatives; held-out minimum must be agreed before exposure.

evaluationMetrics.definition: Rejected incompatible task+treatment alternatives excluded at the appropriate stage / all adjudicated incompatible alternatives; report false exclusion of valid alternatives separately.
evaluationMetrics.proposedGate: 100% on explicit hard-constraint regression negatives; review subjective negative thresholds before evaluation.

evaluationMetrics.definition: Distinct compatible families/meaningfully different variants reached versus independently adjudicated expected set; same-family duplicate cards and hidden alternatives also reported.
evaluationMetrics.proposedGate: No silent loss of a validated alternative before display; display capacity is explicit, overflow remains accessible.

evaluationMetrics.definition: Correctly preserved intentional no-template/clip/continuation routes and zero forced-template suggestions; separately test tasks wrongly suppressed from template discovery.
evaluationMetrics.proposedGate: All deterministic route fixtures pass; no-template does not claim media availability.

evaluationMetrics.definition: Exact span coverage, role/participant/unit/relationship preservation; separately adjudicated split/merge appropriateness.
evaluationMetrics.proposedGate: Zero omitted/invented narration and zero withholding violation; editorial segmentation judged with both split and keep counterexamples.

evaluationMetrics.definition: False native-fit assertions; stale/missing mapping, timing, copy and asset evidence; unknown-to-rejected coercions.
evaluationMetrics.proposedGate: Zero unsupported native-fit claims and zero unknown-to-exhausted transitions.

evaluationMetrics.definition: Median/p90 review minutes, cards inspected, unresolved decisions and reopened cases per completed task, with coverage/quality held constant.
evaluationMetrics.proposedGate: Baseline to be measured; editor sets improvement target before rollout, no invented time savings.

evaluationMetrics.definition: Same-artifact replay identity, provider response validation, subject-name paraphrase/renaming checks and genuinely untouched package quality.
evaluationMetrics.proposedGate: Deterministic fixtures and dependency hashes pass; quality thresholds frozen before held-out review.
